assumption_ranking.activating_condition: any claim that names a symptom, condition or treatment invalidates the reading and must be reworked
if Assignment-1 research shows the category is saturated with restraint, this assumption fails and the register must be re-argued
if the operator re-earmarks the eligibility scope, those markers must be re-run through CAP-14 before any ranking
if a claim's support would depend only on pillar-register atoms, the claim is NO_CHART_SUPPORT for the spine and must be downgraded
any cost, timeline or tool-selection statement requires a case-side input that does not exist in this run

invalid_chains.chain: C011/C012 (asset sequence, production path) -> campaign window
invalid_chains.why: the chain would cross an undeclared timeframe_of_interest; the chain is blocked, not resolved

conflict_register.why: the case's traceability requirement: every major decision must trace to a specific Assignment-1 research finding, insight, or mood-board pin — a chart-selected name can never do that

conditions.handling: analysed the 7 most decision-relevant facets; deferred facets listed with owner_phase and a gap row (CAP-17 step 4)

uncertainty_policy: certainty is computed by tools/validate_package.py from the cited sets under the archetype rubric; it is capped by the grounding tier and reduced by each counterevidence atom
